text:
sara-p: Quick sync — customer X asked for per-tenant SLA tiers with anycast fallback + feature-flagged degradation. Need rollout plan + kill-switch semantics. Thoughts?
igor: do we have capacity metrics per-region for anycast fallbacks? if fallback goes to cheaper region we must ensure latency SLOs.
kevin-sre: we have historical p95 by region. fallback-to-anycast will add ~40-80ms avg for EU->US failover, but p99 spikes unclear. I can run a smoke test.
maya-prod: proposal: staged rollout by tenant tier (gold -> silver -> all), region warm-up windows, and a default automatic rollback if error-rate > 0.5% for 10m.
luis-sales: customer X requires 99.9 SLA for gold; they will accept briefly higher latency during failover but not errors. they asked about manual approval for gold cutover.
igor: manual approval for gold makes sense. for silver we can do auto-roll and monitor. what about feature flag naming + guardrail?
sara-p: flag naming: ff.anycast.fallback.{tenant_tier}.{region}. Example: ff.anycast.fallback.gold.eu-west-1. Keep default OFF.
maya-prod: add a global quick-kill flag: ff.anycast.fallback.global_kill. must be sticky and replicate across regions in <15s.
kevin-sre: ops checklist draft:
```
- preflight: capacity run (10% traffic shadow)
- create canary: 1% traffic from non-gold tenants
- monitor: p50/p95/p99 latency, 5xx, token error rate, spool queue length
- escalation: page SRE on >0.3% 5xx or sustained p99 > SLA for 5m
- rollback: flip global_kill + route back to primary pool
```
igor: what about A/B for quality? if anycast routes to different model variants we must measure quality regressions.
maya-prod: yes — A/B traffic should include identical prompts sample and quick eval on key metrics (F1, hallucination rate, response-length). baseline vs fallback.
luis-sales: timeline ask from customer: want soft launch next month; can we promise manual cutover for gold then?
kevin-sre: tentative: 2 weeks for preflight + infra, 1 week for canary + telemetry, 1 week for staged roll, so ~4 weeks. manual cutover path available earlier if ops sign-off.
sara-p: decision items for this week: 1) approve flag names and kill-switch semantics (maya). 2) SRE to run region latency smoke (kevin). 3) Sales to confirm gold manual-cutover window (luis).
maya-prod: I approve names + global_kill behavior. will create RFC doc and flag rules.
kevin-sre: starting smoke now, will post short results in this thread in ~2h.
luis-sales: I’ll confirm with customer by EOD.
deploy-bot: scheduled: smoke-test-job started for eu-west-1 -> us-east-1 routing (job id: smoke-1729981111). logs: https://ci.internal/jobs/1729981111
sara-p: great — thanks all. tagging @kevin-sre for results and @maya-prod for the RFC link when ready.
kevin-sre: smoke results: added here — p95 increased 60ms, p99 +110ms, no 5xx during run. attaching short log snippet.
sara-p: sounds ok for soft launch with manual cutover. next: maya to publish RFC + rollout playbook, kevin to run a longer 24h soak, luis to lock in customer expectations.
maya-prod: will publish RFC by tomorrow morning and include the exact rollout steps and dashboards.
kevin-sre: starting 24h soak now (job id: soak-1729981111). will report back.
luis-sales: customer confirmed manual cutover window. thanks. :thumbsup:
sara-p: closing action: set calendar for canary start in 3 weeks unless soak fails. will follow up in product-weekly. Thanks everyone.
